summary: the smp suite's cases on i686, against a kernel that ignores maxcpus=, a tick that does not preempt a kernel thread, and an NMI handler that reports the fault and does not panic

argv: ARCH=i686 sh tests/proofs/guest.sh make rach2 && ARCH=i686 sh tests/proofs/guest.sh copy ${WORK} rach2/kernel

faults.name: maxcpus-ignored
faults.summary: the boot line's maxcpus= never read, so that a machine of four processors with maxcpus=2 starts all four, which the maxcpus-2 case finds in the kernel's count and in smpmusl's

faults.name: kthread-not-preempted
faults.summary: the tick switching no process without an address space of its own, so that the debug shell and its two kernel threads are never preempted and the preemption test never ends, which the preempt case finds

faults.name: nmi-no-panic
faults.summary: the NMI's handler reporting the fault of the machine and returning to what it interrupted instead of panicking, which the nmi case finds
